ez-comfy-stack flux-to-ltx pipeline

Flow: text → FLUX.2 Klein NVFP4 image → LTX-2.3 I2V + audio

Defaults: LAB_FLUX_TIER=fast, LAB_LTX_TIER=balanced
Memory: ~90Gi limit to keep both model families resident on GB10

1. ./scripts/manage.sh download-models
2. ./scripts/manage.sh start
3. Open http://<spark-ip>:8188 and load this workflow note
4. Keep models loaded; avoid unloading between stages

Stop before reboot: ./scripts/manage.sh stop
